response.sql: WITH acct AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id), per_account AS (SELECT acct.region, acct.account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS avg_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM acct JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = acct.account_id GROUP BY acct.region, acct.account_id), region_stats AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amount) AS amount_avg, AVG(avg_balance) AS balance_avg FROM per_account GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount_avg) AS mean_amount_avg FROM region_stats) SELECT r.region, r.amount_avg, r.balance_avg, r.amount_avg / o.mean_amount_avg AS amount_ratio FROM region_stats r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_amount_avg IS NOT NULL AND o.mean_amount_avg <> 0;
